title: Understanding Harmful Communication
description: This course helps participants recognise communication patterns that create fear, confusion, or emotional harm. It supports the development of respectful, safe, and clear communication.
learningOutcomes: Understand how tone, language, and intent affect others.
Recognise how communication impacts children’s emotional safety.

modules.title: Harmful Communication Patterns
modules.content: Explores criticism, threats, sarcasm, and intimidation.

modules.title: Impact on Emotional Safety
modules.content: Shows how communication affects trust and wellbeing.

modules.title: Building Respectful Communication
modules.content: Provides tools for clarity, calmness, and respect.
